messages:
Liam (AE): HalcyonBank wants a quick POC to replace CompetitorZ with Redwood. Main asks: prompt/response parity, exact webhook semantics, token billing equivalence, and security questionnaire answers. Can SE + SRE support?
Nina (SE): I can run parity checks and produce a delta report. Do they expect exact token-for-token billing parity or a translated mapping for forecasting?
HalcyonBank POC - Ravi: Forecast mapping is fine. Our finance team wants an example monthly bill for 100k requests at our typical 600+200 token split. Also need to ensure webhooks preserve their event_id and retry behavior.
Liam (AE): Noted. Also they use CompetitorZ's custom metadata headers on webhooks. Can Redwood echo those or attach them to the response body?
Nina (SE): Redwood preserves incoming metadata if forwarded as part of the request; for webhook callbacks we include original request_id in x-redwood-request header and we support custom metadata in response body under `meta` by convention. I'll include a sample mapping.
Omar (SRE): For a Dedicated POC we can provision a small pool with customer KMS. Need their allowed CIDRs and whether they want us to use their CMK or a Redwood-managed key.
Zoe (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. HalcyonBank flagged encryption-in-transit + at-rest with HSM-backed keys and a subprocessors list. Also want longer audit log retention for the trial (180 days).
HalcyonBank POC - Ravi: We'll use our CMK in GCP KMS. CIDRs sent via email. We need webhook retry semantics <= 5 retries and exponential backoff; idempotency recommended.
Nina (SE): Example idempotency usage: include `response_id` on generate calls and validate duplicate suppression server-side. For webhook at-least-once is default; we include a delivery-id header and exponential backoff 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s.
Liam (AE): Deliverables to HalcyonBank: 1) parity report (intent F1 + sample diffs), 2) token mapping and example invoice, 3) webhook semantics doc, 4) security QA answers.
Omar (SRE): Provisioning started. deploy-bot: job 9204 initiated by Omar. Steps: allocate pool -> attach GCP KMS -> set egress IPs. ETA 6h.
deploy-bot: Job 9204 in progress: networking -> kms attach -> smoke tests.
Zoe (Security): Drafted QA responses and SOC/ISO certs attached. Flagged 2 items needing legal: subprocessor list and DPA amendments for HSM usage. Sending to Ravi.
Nina (SE): Running 40-prompt corpus now against CompetitorZ and Redwood. I'll post results (intent F1, token counts, sample mismatches) in 24h.
Omar (SRE): Provisioning complete. Test endpoints and static egress IPs emailed to Ravi. deploy-bot: Job 9204 completed.
Nina (SE): Parity summary uploaded: intent F1 delta 1.9%, median token delta +2.3%. Sample mapping and a small token-conversion script available at https://files.redwoodinference.com/pocs/halcyon/parity-1799998001.zip
HalcyonBank POC - Ravi: Looks promising. We'll run integration tests and surface any webhook corner-cases. Thanks for the fast turn.
Liam (AE): Great work team. Reopen thread for any blockers; I'll coordinate contract/DPA next steps once legal returns. :thumbsup:
